scope: Account the SCALE name parsed from DXF group 300 through the same owner/counter used for inherited group-2 name parsing.

sourceFinding.observation: DRW_Scale::parseCode maps group 300 to the inherited name member; DRW_TableEntry::parseCode maps group 2 to that same member.
sourceFinding.resolution: Add a protected base helper that reserves replacements against the existing m_dxfRetainedNameBytes counter and shared lease; route SCALE group 300 through it.

implementation.accounting: Both group-2 base parsing and group-300 SCALE parsing use the same live-name counter and reserve-before-replacement semantics.
implementation.layout: No per-object data member or class layout change was added.
contractLimits: Logical parsed DXF name length only; not allocator capacity, RSS, or a total process-memory cap.
Public post-callback edits, DWG string storage, and writer/projection copies remain outside this owner.

selectorCoverage: Generated direct parser streams cover ASCII and Binary DXF, with group 2 setting an old name before group 300 replaces it.
Exact replacement-peak cap succeeds; one-byte-under preserves the previous name and charge.
Copy/assignment lifetime and final reset release are verified against the common base name lease.

Generated full ASCII and Binary OBJECTS input refuses before addScale callbacks at cap-minus-one with ResourceLimit/dxf-retained-byte-budget, then succeeds on same-facade exact-cap retry through a following SCALE sentinel.
Binary input is generated in temporary storage and removed; no persistent fixture or CTest was added.
